text:
maria: Hey @support — I scanned the QR we export from the dashboard and now every request returns 401 invalid_api_key. Happens in curl and our devbox.

alex_support: Hi Maria, can you paste the raw header or the curl you used? What client/OS? :magnifying_glass_tilted_left:

maria: sure — macOS, here's the curl I tried:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_–A3bC9x7Q" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I just replaced the real suffix with A3bC9x7Q for privacy.

alex_support: hm that token has a long dash after sk_live. That looks like an en-dash/figure-dash rather than ASCII hyphen. Can you check the bytes? Run: `printf '%s' 'sk_live_–A3bC9x7Q' | xxd -g 1`

maria: ran that, output pasted below:
```
00000000: 73 6b 5f 6c 69 76 65 e2 80 93 41 33 62 43 39 78  sk_live...A3bC9x
```
The `e2 80 93` bytes match U+2013 (en-dash).

jj_engineer: thanks for the repro — confirmed. Our dashboard QR encoder (and the export flow) picked up a typographic dash during generation for some builds and encoded U+2013 into the token string. The token validator on the API expects ASCII subset (letters, digits, underscore, hyphen). Server rejects non-ASCII with 401.

jj_engineer: short-term workaround: replace the en-dash with ASCII hyphen and retry. Example on mac/linux:
```
echo 'sk_live_–A3bC9x7Q' | tr '–' '-' > fixed_token.txt
# then use contents of fixed_token.txt as the key
```
Or just paste and manually retype the dash.

samir: tagging @jj_engineer — can we add validation in the dashboard export to normalize or warn? This will crop up for users who scan QR images from phones (some QR libs normalize characters).

jj_engineer: created ENG-4592 to add stricter generation (force ASCII hyphen) + UI warning on import/scan. I'm leaning against silent normalization on server-side because that can mask other encoding bugs; instead return a clearer error like `invalid character in api key: U+2013 en-dash` to help debugging. Will add both ticket and a small dashboard patch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: dashboard/qr-fix branch -> staging (#ENG-4592). ETA ~48h.

maria: replaced the dash manually and calls now succeed, thanks! :tada:

alex_support: great — marking as resolved for this thread. We'll follow up when ENG-4592 lands and paste the changelog here. :wave:
